page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.4xlarge is a compute-focused instance within the Enhanced family, deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. Compute resources consist of 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, defining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core.

The system does not bundle local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent operating system and data requirements. Dedicated GPU hardware accelerators are not present. For network connectivity, the instance provides a high baseline bandwidth of 23 Gbps to support data transfers, though it provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating separate routing or IP allocation.

By maintaining a lean memory footprint relative to its dedicated core count, the instance avoids the cost overhead of excess RAM for compute-dominant operations. This makes it a resource-efficient choice for parallel execution frameworks, batch compute processing, continuous integration pipelines, application backend services, and distributed microservices that demand dedicated processing cores and high network capacity without high memory requirements.
